ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: كَادِحٌ is in the derivative form: كاَدِح
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/د/ح   k–d–ḥ to scratch or scrape off the skin; to bite; to scratch a living; hardship; drudgery.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
كَدْح kadḥ and كاَدِح kādiḥ.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
كاَدِح kādiḥ [act. part.] one who strives hard, labours after, toils, applies himself diligently

(84:6) يَاأَيُّهَا الإِنْسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلاَقِيهِ Humankind, you are laboriously toiling towards your Lord, and you will meet Him.
